SELF_AUDIT.SCALABILITY_CURVE_EXPLANATION: GlobalQualityWeight is read through LocRegistry.ResolveGlobalQualityWeight. BabelLookupScalability clamps requested lookup count to a low-budget lane of min(20, requested) below the 0.5 transition, then uses ramp=(quality-0.5)*2, smooth=ramp*ramp*(3-2*ramp), and math.lerp(lowBudget, requested, smooth). Below 0.3, non-critical visible/PDA text prefetch therefore collapses toward the 20-lookup budget instead of disabling UI. The decrypt job itself remains O(n) for requested visible bytes only; callers choose fewer visible slices as the lookup budget drops.
